attachments.title: OpenSSH 8.7 and ssh-rsa host key
attachments.text: Hi, OpenSSH disabled the ssh-rsa signature scheme and now when I want to push/pull to/from my repositories I receive the following error: Unable to negotiate with 104.192.141.1 port 22: no matching host key type found. Their offer: ssh-rsa,ssh-dss fatal: Could not read from remote repository. Pleas...
